description.it: Analizzare e risolvere un pod che crasha
description.en: Analyze and fix a crashing pod

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con comando errato che causa crash
2. Osserva lo stato con kubectl get pods -w
3. Usa describe e logs per diagnosticare
4. Identifica la causa del crash
hints: Crea un pod busybox con comando sbagliato
exercises.solution:
kubectl run crasher --image=busybox -- sh -c 'exit 1'
kubectl get pods -w &
kubectl describe pod crasher
kubectl logs crasher --previous

# Causa: exit 1 dal comando
# Fix: cambiare comando

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con immagine inesistente
2. Verifica lo stato e gli eventi
3. Identifica il messaggio di errore
4. Correggi l'immagine
exercises.solution:
kubectl run bad-image --image=nginx:nonexistent
ekubectl describe pod bad-image
# Output: ImagePullBackOff - image not found

kubectl set image pod/bad-image bad-image=nginx:latest
kubectl get pod bad-image
exercises.validation: kubectl describe pod bad-image 2>&1 | grep -c 'ImagePullBackOff' || echo 'Fixed'

description.it: Testare la risoluzione DNS nel cluster

exercises.task:
1. Crea un Service kubernetes standard
2. Da un pod di test, risolvi kubernetes.default
3. Verifica che l'IP corrisponda al Service
4. Testa un Service personalizzato
hints: nslookup o dig da un pod busybox
kubectl get svc kubernetes per IP atteso
Il Service kubernetes è sempre presente
exercises.solution:
kubectl run dns-test --image=busybox --rm -it -- nslookup kubernetes
kubectl get svc kubernetes
# L'IP dovrebbe corrispondere

kubectl create deployment nginx --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment nginx --port=80
kubectl run dns-test2 --image=busybox --rm -it -- nslookup nginx

description.it: Analizzare un container terminato per memoria

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con memory limit basso
2. Esegui un comando che consuma memoria
3. Osserva OOMKilled
4. Verifica exit code e stato
hints: Usa un loop che alloca memoria
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: memory-hog
spec:
  containers:
  - name: hog
    image: python:3.11-slim
    command: ['python', '-c', 'x=" "*100000000; print(len(x))']
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 10Mi
EOF

kubectl get pod memory-hog -w
kubectl describe pod memory-hog | grep -A5 'Last State'
kubectl get pod memory-hog -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.reason}'

description.it: Verificare che un Service sia raggiungibile

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment e Service
2. Verifica gli Endpoints
3. Testa connettività da un pod di test
4. Verifica response
hints: kubectl get endpoints per verificare IP pod
wget -qO- service-name dal pod di test
curl se il pod ha curl installato
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment web --port=80
kubectl get endpoints web
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- wget -qO- web

exercises.task:
1. Crea un ServiceAccount e un pod che lo usa
2. Il pod prova a listare i pod
3. Verifica che fallisce per permessi
4. Crea Role e RoleBinding per permettere
hints: kubectl auth can-i --list per vedere permessi
exercises.solution:
kubectl create serviceaccount app-sa

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: rbac-test
spec:
  serviceAccountName: app-sa
  containers:
  - name: kubectl
    image: bitnami/kubectl
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'kubectl get pods && sleep 3600']
EOF

kubectl logs rbac-test
# Error: pods is forbidden

kubectl create role pod-reader --verb=get,list --resource=pods
kubectl create rolebinding app-pod-reader --role=pod-reader --serviceaccount=default:app-sa

description.it: Risolvere un claim che non si binda

exercises.task:
1. Crea un PVC con StorageClass inesistente
2. Verifica che rimanga Pending
3. Identifica il problema negli eventi
4. Crea la StorageClass o cambia il PVC
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: stuck-pvc
spec:
  storageClassName: nonexistent-class
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
EOF

kubectl describe pvc stuck-pvc
# Events: storageclass.storage.k8s.io "nonexistent-class" not found

kubectl create -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: nonexistent-class
provisioner: kubernetes.io/no-provisioner
EOF

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment backend con Service
2. Applica NetworkPolicy deny-all
3. Verifica che il traffico è bloccato
4. Modifica policy per permettere traffico
hints: NetworkPolicy deny all ha ingress vuoto
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment backend --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment backend --port=80

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-all
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
EOF

kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- wget -qO- backend --timeout=5
# Connection refused/timeout

kubectl patch networkpolicy deny-all --type='json' -p='[{"op": "add", "path": "/spec/ingress", "value": [{}]}]'

exercises.task:
1. Visualizza i nodi del cluster
2. Verifica Conditions per ogni nodo
3. Identifica eventuali problemi (MemoryPressure, DiskPressure)
4. Controlla la versione e informazioni kubelet
hints: kubectl get nodes -o wide per versione e IP
exercises.solution:
kubectl get nodes
kubectl describe node $(kubectl get nodes -o name | head -1) | grep -A10 Conditions
kubectl get nodes -o wide

# Esempio output Conditions:
# Ready            True
# MemoryPressure   False
# DiskPressure     False
# PIDPressure      False

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con livenessProbe su endpoint errato
2. Osserva i restart causati dal probe
3. Identifica l'errore negli eventi
4. Correggi il probe
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: probe-fail
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /healthz
        port: 80
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 5
EOF

kubectl describe pod probe-fail | grep -A5 'Liveness'
kubectl get pod probe-fail -w

# Fix: cambia path a /
exercises.validation: kubectl describe pod probe-fail 2>&1 | grep -c 'Liveness' || echo 'No events yet'

description.it: Verificare DNS con tutti i formati

exercises.task:
1. Crea un Service 'myservice' nel namespace 'default'
2. Testa risoluzione con nome corto
3. Testa con namespace
4. Testa FQDN completo
hints: Tutti dovrebbero risolvere allo stesso IP
kubectl get svc myservice per IP atteso
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment myservice --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment myservice --port=80

kubectl run dns-test --image=busybox --rm -it -- sh
echo 'Test in pod:'
nslookup myservice
nslookup myservice.default
nslookup myservice.default.svc.cluster.local
exit

exercises.task:
1. Raccogli kubectl describe di un pod problematico
2. Raccogli log del pod
3. Raccogli eventi del namespace
4. Salva tutto in un file
exercises.solution:
# Simula un problema
kubectl run problem --image=nginx
echo '=== POD DESCRIBE ===' > support-ticket.txt
kubectl describe pod problem >> support-ticket.txt
echo '\n=== POD LOGS ===' >> support-ticket.txt
kubectl logs problem >> support-ticket.txt
echo '\n=== EVENTS ===' >> support-ticket.txt
kubectl get events --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' >> support-ticket.txt
cat support-ticket.txt

description.it: Testare comunicazione tra container nello stesso pod
description.en: Test communication between containers in same pod

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod con due container
2. Il primo gira un server sulla porta 8080
3. Il secondo deve chiamare localhost:8080
4. Verifica la comunicazione
hints: I container nello stesso pod condividono localhost
Un container può servire, l'altro chiamare
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: multi-net
spec:
  containers:
  - name: server
    image: python:3.11-slim
    command: ['python', '-m', 'http.server', '8080']
  - name: client
    image: busybox
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'sleep 5 && wget -qO- http://localhost:8080 && sleep 3600']
EOF

kubectl logs multi-net -c client
exercises.validation: kubectl logs multi-net -c client | grep -c 'Directory listing'

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment con:
   - Immagine inesistente
   - Memory limit troppo basso
   - Service con selettore errato
2. Diagnosticare tutti i problemi
3. Fixare uno alla volta
4. Documentare ogni fix
hints: Inizia con kubectl get pods, poi describe
exercises.solution:
# Deployment problematico
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: broken-app
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: broken
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: broken
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: nginx:bogus
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 1Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: broken-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: wrong
  ports:
  - port: 80
EOF

# Diagnosi
kubectl get pods -l app=broken
kubectl describe pod -l app=broken
kubectl get endpoints broken-svc

# Fix 1: Immagine
kubectl set image deployment/broken-app app=nginx:latest

# Fix 2: Memoria (richiede edit)
kubectl patch deployment broken-app --type='json' -p='[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory", "value":"128Mi"}]'

# Fix 3: Service selector
kubectl delete service broken-svc
kubectl expose deployment broken-app --port=80

exercises.task:
1. Un'applicazione non è raggiungibile
2. Seguire metodologia: pod -> service -> ingress -> dns
3. Documentare ogni step
4. Identificare root cause
hints: Seguire l'ordine: pod ok? endpoints ok? service ok? dns ok?
Usa describe e logs ad ogni step
NetworkPolicy, DNS, TLS possono essere cause
exercises.solution:
# Metodologia troubleshooting

# 1. Pod status
kubectl get pods -l app=myapp
kubectl describe pod -l app=myapp
kubectl logs -l app=myapp --tail=100

# 2. Service e Endpoints
kubectl get svc myapp
kubectl get endpoints myapp
# Se vuoto: selector sbagliato

# 3. DNS test
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- nslookup myapp
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- wget -qO- myapp:80

# 4. Ingress (se applicabile)
kubectl get ingress myapp
kubectl describe ingress myapp

# 5. NetworkPolicy
kubectl get networkpolicy -A
kubectl describe networkpolicy -A

# Documenta:
# - Pod status: Running/Ready
# - Endpoints: ha IP
# - DNS: risolve
# - Connessione: risposta HTTP
# - Root cause: [documentare]
exercises.validation: echo 'Methodology documented' && kubectl get pods -A | head -5
